ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.1.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Local Text-to-Speech Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Local-Text-to-Speech/wiki
Fully offline, on-device neural text-to-speech for RimSynapse, powered by the Kokoro-82M model running through ONNX Runtime. No API keys, no cloud calls, no network required once the model is installed — all synthesis happens on your own machine.
--- Core Systems --- - Kokoro-82M Neural Voice: A compact, high-quality 82M-parameter TTS model bundled with the mod. Produces natural 24kHz speech entirely on-device. - Automatic Hardware Acceleration: Synthesis runs asynchronously on a background thread so the game never stutters. Uses your GPU via DirectML when a compatible graphics card is present (any DirectX 12 GPU — NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel), and falls back to multi-threaded CPU inference otherwise. - Zero-Latency Playback: Generated audio is streamed straight into RimWorld's audio system through RimSynapse Core's shared playback pipeline. - Espeak-ng Phonemization: Bundled grapheme-to-phoneme conversion turns arbitrary English text into the phonemes Kokoro expects.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse Core (Must be loaded before this mod) - Windows 64-bit - ~350 MB free disk space for the bundled model
--- Note --- This is an optional voice backend for the RimSynapse suite. It is fully local and does not transmit any text or audio off your machine.
